The '''shock stick''' was a larger and more powerful version of the [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. It was a large two-handed weapon that was able to incapacitate creatures by delivering [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] energy in a rapid, overwhelming bursts. It could also be mounted on a rifle as a [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
